workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI settings-write IAU candidate

publicIssue.title: Admit runtime settings CLI settings-write IAU

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can register and return a prepare-command shell, but it has no public requirements import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room settings-write contract for provider/version/bitness persistence.

doNotAdmitTogether: live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
splitDecision.reason: Settings mutation is the next useful step after the prepare-command shell, but validation, live-session proof, compare execution, and runtime execution carry separate proof risks and should remain separate IAUs.

allowed: package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0
provider, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness as governed settings facts
only viHistorySuite.runtimeProvider, viHistorySuite.labviewVersion, and viHistorySuite.labviewBitness are updated
unsupported or non-object settings targets fail closed
validation, compare execution, runtime execution, live-session proof, packaging, and Marketplace publication remain blocked until separately admitted
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
GitLab implementation source or private proof packets
active already-running VS Code session uptake proof
VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateTasks: add tests for writing only provider, LabVIEW version, and LabVIEW bitness facts
add tests for preserving unrelated settings content and making the effective settings target explicit
add tests for JSONC comments or trailing commas if admitted by the public spec
implement a pure public MIT settings-write contract without runtime validation or command execution
blockedTasks: live already-running VS Code session uptake proof
source copying from GitLab or GitHub Suite

allowedNextWork: create the public MIT import packet for runtime-settings-cli-settings-write-v1
create the public Spec Kit feature spec, plan, and tasks
add public admission records with implementationStartAllowed false until preflight passes
run public redaction and artifact validation
notAllowedNextWork: implementing settings write before public preflight
copying runtime settings implementation source from another VI History authority
adding VSIX packaging or Marketplace publishing
